column1: # The divergence fields corpus revision 41 retires: every divergence.broiler-js field of the collation area, 240 fields
# under 8 reasons, none of which keeps a field. Milestone SJL-17.5, Broiler.JS's cut-over to the shared collator
# (Broiler-Platform/Broiler.JS#1118, merged as 2f012739), answers each: the corrections of rows O5a, O5b, O7 and O8 and
# the data changes of rows O2, O3, O6 (for windows-latest, decision E-o6w) and O16 that Broiler.JS/CHANGELOG.md lists by
# row. Each reported that it no longer holds in Broiler.JS's run on revision 40 at the after commit, in CI run
# 43812679557's jobs engine vectors (ubuntu-24.04) (artifact engine-vectors-ubuntu-24.04) and engine vectors
# (windows-latest) (artifact engine-vectors-windows-latest), the job revision 40's row named ("once CI's windows-latest
# job has read them"). Broiler.VM has no collation field. Each is listed under the reason its file gave it at revision

# 40, in that file's order: the file's lines at revision 40 less its lines at revision 41. By reason: js-o16-ci-windows 34, js-o2 7, js-o3 4, js-o5a 38, js-o5b 12, js-o6-ci-windows 1, js-o7 85, js-o8 59.
# The reasons' texts at revision 40 follow the list.
# The reasons, as collation-divergences.txt gave them at revision 40:

# collation-divergences.txt js-o16-ci-windows: row O16 (data policy, C5): tailorings in the data, German phonebk and search, root search under en and und ...: Broiler.JS answers "the host's ICU tailoring of each locale", and the row's class says why, each engine's locale list, Broiler.JS's covered list decision E3's; on the CI host of run 41418502645's job 125188274552, engine vectors (windows-latest), Windows Server 2025 (image windows-2025-vs2026 20261021.278.1), whose ICU is the OS's icu.dll, of a version neither the job's log nor the image's software list states, Broiler.JS's answer follows that host and not the tailoring the vector holds: the collator its CompareInfo gives for de-u-co-phonebk, for de with collation "phonebk", for de with usage "search" and for en with usage "search" applies no tailoring and orders as de and en do without it (U+00E4 < ae, U+00C4 < AE, a = U+00E4 at base, U+0622 < U+0623 < U+0627, and = against U+2260 = at base), as the reference does with the tailoring dropped, while under und with usage "search" it applies root search; the vector matches on the host revision 34's first runs were taken on (Ubuntu 24.04.5, ICU 74.2), where a run reports this divergence as no longer holding; answered at SJL-17.5, where CLDR 48.2.0's data replaces the host's for the covered locales, German phonebook and search and root search among them (JSD-0084 decision E3)

# collation-divergences.txt js-o2: row O2 (data policy, C5): a pair of consecutive lines of CLDR 48.2.0's archived CollationTest files out of the file's order: Broiler.JS answers "pairs out of order in both files, more in the shifted one", and the row's class says why, "the host's ICU 74 carries UCA 15.1's weights", so a code point UCA 16 or 17 weighs anew or adds sorts otherwise; the host's ICU 74.2, asked the pair through its C API under the file's settings, answers as Broiler.JS does; answered at SJL-17.5, where CLDR 48.2.0's root replaces the host's ICU for the covered locales (JSD-0084 decision E3)

# collation-divergences.txt js-o3: row O3 (data policy, C5): Han across blocks, CJK Extension J (U+323B0 to U+33479, added in Unicode 17.0): Broiler.JS orders unified ideographs "as the host's ICU orders" them, by radical and stroke, its expectation here, but the host's ICU 74.2 (Unicode 15.1) has no data for Extension J and weighs it as an unassigned code point, after every ideograph it knows (the dated note of 2026-11-02 on row O3); a host whose ICU carries Unicode 17 orders it as out; the Han order is SJL-17.3's to decide (finding F1), and SJL-17.5's cut-over takes Broiler.JS's root from the shared data

# collation-divergences.txt js-o5a: row O5a (a correction of Broiler.JS): ignorePunctuation true "is .NET's IgnoreSymbols (:6228-6229): symbols ignored too"; the reference and Broiler.VM ignore spaces and punctuation, CLDR's maxVariable punctuation, and keep symbols; for a CollationTest pair, the host's ICU 74.2 under UTS #10's shifted alternate with maxVariable punctuation answers as the reference does, so the difference is the option's mapping and not the host's data; corrected at SJL-17.5 (JSD-0084's list of Broiler.JS's corrections)

# collation-divergences.txt js-o5b: row O5b (a correction of Broiler.JS): below the tertiary strength Broiler.JS keeps width differences and the squared katakana word U+3300 apart from their decompositions ("the host's IgnoreCase | IgnoreNonSpace keeps the width and compatibility difference"), at base and, by the dated notes of 2026-11-02 on row O5b, at accent and case too: NBSP against a space at base, U+FF21 against A and U+3300 against its katakana at base and accent, and a against U+FF41 at base, accent and case, the pairs its run differed on; the other compatibility forms the vectors hold (U+FB01, U+01C6, U+2460, U+00AA, U+00BD, U+2163, U+00B2, U+24D0) it answers as the reference does; the reference and Broiler.VM fold the width forms and U+3300, and the host's ICU 74.2 at the secondary and primary strengths answers as the reference does; corrected at SJL-17.5

# collation-divergences.txt js-o6-ci-windows: row O6 (same in both, and for this answer data policy, C5, by the dated note of 2026-11-02 on the row, the owner's decision E-o6w): sensitivity base under de with usage "search": Broiler.JS answers "the same orders" as the reference and Broiler.VM on the correspondence's host, where German search's tailoring, row O16's data, applies; on the CI host of run 41418502645's job 125188274552, engine vectors (windows-latest), Windows Server 2025 (image windows-2025-vs2026 20261021.278.1), whose ICU is the OS's icu.dll, of a version neither the job's log nor the image's software list states, the collator its CompareInfo gives for de with usage "search" applies no tailoring, so a against U+00E4 at base is = where German search has a < U+00E4, as the reference answers with usage "search" dropped; that is the host's answer, as row O16's is, whether from its icu.dll's data or from how the runtime builds the culture there, which the run does not establish (under und with usage "search" that host applies root search); the vector matches on the host revision 34's first runs were taken on (Ubuntu 24.04.5, ICU 74.2), where a run reports this divergence as no longer holding; answered at SJL-17.5, where CLDR 48.2.0's data replaces the host's for German search (JSD-0084 decision E3)

# collation-divergences.txt js-o7: row O7 (a correction of Broiler.JS): numeric "resolved and not applied: resolvedOptions().numeric is true, the order is the code-unit-like digit order ("a10" < "a2"): Compare passes no option for it (:6221-6229)"; the reference and Broiler.VM compare runs of decimal digits by value; corrected at SJL-17.5

# collation-divergences.txt js-o8: row O8 (a correction of Broiler.JS): caseFirst "resolved and not applied: "a" < "A" whatever the option"; the reference and Broiler.VM apply it on the tertiary and case levels; corrected at SJL-17.5
